rootMeshAnimation.fact: The root mesh's animation is bound through 0x106b3990 -> SetSkelAnim 0x106b38f0 (gates: instance non-null, no animation yet, mesh+0x248 non-null). Body sub-instances (USubSkeletalMeshInstance) skin with the owning actor's root bone transforms (0x106c5070); a UExtraSkeletalMeshInstance uses its own.
